name: Fugitive
otherNightReminder: Wake up a living player and have them choose either 1 or 2, then put them to sleep. Wake up another living player and have them choose 1 or 2, then put them to sleep. If at least 1 of them choose 1, put a Good Potion on the other player. If only 1 of them chose 2, wake them and show them the other player and their potions. If both players chose 2, put an evil potion on both.
ability: Each night* 2 players choose either 1) The other receives a Good potion, or 2) to learn the other and their potions. If both choose 2, each receive an Evil potion instead.
flavor:
I've run so far away,
I ran all night and day,
so far away,
but I couldn't get away.
